rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all four views and avoids obvious cross-view collisions, so the basic repair integrity is decent. However, it reads mostly as a compact abstract block with a slight stepped/inflated top, not as a neighborhood-living building with an active ground threshold. The verified access edge is not answered with a clear void, notch, court, or entry seam; instead the mass stays largely sealed. The silhouette is legible but remains closer to a generic sculpted box than to a public mixed-use body. Because the program brief requires an active ground edge and one clear public void or terrace, this cannot hard-pass program fit.
